For Humanities, you will need to select courses from two different subjects. The following list includes courses that were selected by faculty and advisors in this area. You can choose a course from this list or you can choose a course from the complete list of Humanities courses found on the AAS-DTA degree worksheet. Please consult an advisor or refer to the AAS-DTA degree worksheet to learn about additional course options. 

Please note that you must take one course in either Social Sciences, Humanities, or Electives that fulfills the Diversity Degree Requirement (DDR) at some point in your degree. ANTH 208, CES 100, and CES 170 will fulfill the DDR requirement.

recommendedOpportunity.title: Meet with Academic Advisor
recommendedOpportunity.shortDescription: Set up an appointment this quarter
recommendedOpportunity.longDescription: It is important to set up an education plan that is specific to your goals. Every university and major will require slightly different prerequisites. It is highly recommended that you speak with a BC academic advisor to ensure you are meeting program, degree, and university transfer requirements.

recommendedOpportunity.title: Transfer Milestone
recommendedOpportunity.longDescription: It is important to attend the transfer and information sessions offered by transfer institutions you are considering so you are familiar with the admissions requirements, expectations, deadlines, and areas of specialization. Please check the world language admissions and graduation requirements as these will vary with each school.
